description: This file implements a distributed lock acquisition mechanism for the Superset project, supporting Redis and database fallback methods.

classes.name: AcquireDistributedLock
classes.description: Class to acquire a distributed lock using Redis or a database fallback, with TTL management and error handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the lock with namespace, parameters, and TTL.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock via Redis or database.

methods.name: _acquire_redis
methods.description: Uses Redis SET NX EX command to acquire lock atomically.

methods.name: _acquire_kv
methods.description: Uses database KeyValue table to acquire lock, with cleanup of expired entries.
